description: Build a net-new microservice from scratch: bootstrap a Go service with HTTP API, set up CI pipeline (lint → test → build → deploy), add observability (structured logging, metrics, health checks), configure auto-scaling (HPA), and deploy to a Kubernetes cluster. No existing infrastructure to migrate from — this is a greenfield build. Must include: service skeleton, Dockerfile, Helm chart, CI/CD pipeline, Prometheus metrics, structured JSON logging, graceful shutdown, liveness/readiness probes. Risk factors: no existing patterns to follow, security baseline not established day one, observability as an afterthought. Tools available: Go, Docker, Helm, GitHub Actions, kubectl, Prometheus.
